query: After ComfyUI PR #15063 the LTX latent upscaler is a ModelPatcherDynamic, but LTX2SamplingPreviewOverride still calls .to(device)/direct module ops on it, raising AttributeError before the first sampling step.

desired.outcome: OP-documented workaround: disconnect the latent_upscale_model input from LTX2SamplingPreviewOverride (native LTXVLatentUpsampler still works). Proper fix requires KJNodes to use the patcher API; not yet landed.
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies correct root cause; fix actionable and directionally correct.
desired.answer_guidance: OP-documented workaround: disconnect the latent_upscale_model input from LTX2SamplingPreviewOverride (native LTXVLatentUpsampler still works). Proper fix requires KJNodes to use the patcher API; not yet landed.
desired.guidance_note: Known fix from the original issue thread. Use to verify the diagnosis targets the right root cause; alternative fixes that resolve the same root cause are acceptable.

_tags.hidden_requirement: Understand a core PR's API migration (model -> ModelPatcherDynamic) and either rewire the workflow to bypass the incompatible node or apply the patcher API correctly.
